decisions: Journey 10 Overall Position is a derived read model and is never mutated by settlement.
Settlement resolves exact payer, recipient, amount, one currency, source groups/items and method.
Journey 11 prepares or authorizes a scoped payment and never closes it.
Payer-marked-sent never equals receiver-confirmed or closed.
External/manual payments require canonical receiver confirmation.
An exact finalized transfer may close only its exact deterministically matched payment item.
Partial payments preserve the remaining balance and source lineage.
Disputes block only dependent payment items.
Agents prepare by default and execute only under exact valid delegation.
Authorization, replay, idempotency and transition checks are deterministic backend logic.
Payment systems and agent protocols remain replaceable integrations.
Credentials, wallet secrets and private keys never become ChopDot domain data.
